geometry.lengthNote: Tier-0 planar geometry length (EPSG:3057), reprojected offline from WGS84 -- not a driving-distance contract. This response makes no claim about winter closure, driving conditions, current access, or whether any road or service is open.

accessApproach.note: Each offset is a planar straight-line distance from that endpoint's own route point to that place's own owner coordinate, never a driving distance, never counted in lengthM.
